answer: Prayers & Duties >> Sawm (Fasting) Question ID: 15539 Country: India Title: Assalamualaikum Warahmatullah, I am a patient of Acidity and gastric problem.This acidity gives me a lot of trouble. I have met with many doctors (MBBS / good practitioner) , all of them have prescribed me not to be empty stomach for more than 2 Hours. Now please tell me that should i have fast (Roza)in the month of Ramzaan or can i leave it? or please tell me any solution to have fast(Roza) in coming Ramadhaan and acid /Gastric is also not produced. Jazakallah... Question: Assalamualaikum Warahmatullah, I am a patient of Acidity and gastric problem.This acidity gives me a lot of trouble. I have met with many doctors (MBBS / good practitioner) , all of them have prescribed me not to be empty stomach for more than 2 Hours. Now please tell me that should i have fast (Roza)in the month of Ramzaan or can i leave it? or please tell me any solution to have fast(Roza) in coming Ramadhaan and acid /Gastric is also not produced. Jazakallah... Answer ID: 15539 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1442/1370=B=1430) Take 20-25 grains of good raisin ( munaqqa ) and boil it in 3 cup water until the raisins swell. Take one cup of the water after the lunch and take one cup after dinner. You may eat the raisins as well, but take out the seeds. Also, take Jawarish Shahi 10 gm in the morning and evening with fresh water. If you feel exceedingly hungry because of fasting in Ramadan, you can leave fasting and should make it up later. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
